 Indiana Packers Corporation 

Indiana Packers celebrated the grand opening of our new Freezer Distribution Center in Delphi with a ribbon-cutting ceremony on August 13. The 96,761-square-foot facility more than doubles our warehouse space and increases frozen storage capacity by over 12x strengthening our ability to serve customers across the U.S. and in more than 20 export markets. This $44 million project, "is about much more than adding storage space," said Eric Sheiss, President and Chief Operating Officer of Indiana Packers Corporation. "The distribution center transforms how we move product to customers, both across the United States, and around the world. By Michelle Weir, Local Democracy Reporter

Published 18th Aug 2026, 16:31 BST Updated 18th Aug 2026, 16:55 BST

## Planning permission was granted for a proposed new £18m DHL premises at Ballyearl Business Park at Antrim and Newtownabbey Borough Council’s Planning Committee on Monday.

The proposal is for the erection of a storage and distribution warehouse building with ancillary facilities, office space, internal chiller unit, solar panels and external yard, including HGV and car parking, landscaping and infrastructure works.

Access is proposed from an established entrance into Ballyearl Business Park at Houston’s Corner, Newtownabbey.

A planning officer told the meeting it was considered the proposal would represent a “significant contribution to the regional economy”.

The company will expand warehouse operations into an existing 85,000-square-foot facility located adjacent to their current property at 401 S. 41st St E, formerly occupied by Customized Distribution Services (CDS), bringing the site back into active industrial use.

# Bis zu 800 neue Arbeitsplätze: Ceva sucht Personal für Frankfurter Logistikzentrum

Ceva Logistics baut seine Personalgewinnung für den neuen Standort in Frankfurt (Oder) aus. Langfristig sollen zwischen 500 und 800 Arbeitsplätze entstehen. Gesucht werden Beschäftigte für Lager, Technik, Verwaltung und Führungsaufgaben.

 Von Paul Berger 02. August 2026 · 2 Min. Lesezeit 

## Eigene Internetseite für den Standort eingerichtet

Das Unternehmen hat für Frankfurt eine dreisprachige Recruiting-Seite eingerichtet.

Dort finden Interessenten Informationen zu Stellenprofilen, Zusatzleistungen, Bewerbungsverfahren und direkten Ansprechpartnern. Die Mehrsprachigkeit ist für eine Grenzstadt von besonderer Bedeutung, weil auch Beschäftigte aus Polen angesprochen werden können.

Bereits beim Stadtfest „Bunter Hering“ war Ceva mit einem eigenen Pavillon vertreten, um unmittelbar mit möglichen Bewerbern ins Gespräch zu kommen.

# Galletas Gullón creará 140 empleos en una plataforma logística y una nueva fábrica en Palencia

- 3 septiembre 2026

Palencia (EFE).- Galletas Gullón invertirá 196,5 millones de euros y sumará 140 nuevos empleos a su plantilla de 2.300 personas con la construcción de una plataforma logística robotizada en Aguilar de Campoo y un nuevo centro de preparados alimenticios y productos dietéticos en Villamuriel de Cerrato.

La empresa, que tiene toda su actividad productiva concentrada en dos fábricas, Gullón y VIDA, situadas en Aguilar de Campoo, extenderá su actividad al sur de la provincia con la construcción de un nuevo centro en Villamuriel de Cerrato, tal y como recoge el Proyecto de inversión en logística y nuevos alimentos homogeneizados y dietéticos en Palencia.

Interior de las instalaciones de Galletas Gullón en Aguilar de Campoo. EFE/A. Álvarez

Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

# Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

 Wagner Logistics 

Oct 14, 2026, 08:54 ET

NORTH KANSAS CITY, Mo., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wagner Logistics, a nationwide provider of third-party logistics, today announced it has signed a multi-year agreement with a Kansas City-area manufacturer to launch a new manufacturing support and warehouse operations program in Liberty, Mo.

The new operation includes two leased warehouse facilities in the Liberty area totaling more than 830,000 square feet. Wagner expects to add 79 new local jobs over the next two years, starting immediately. The company will also make a multi-million-dollar investment in equipment, infrastructure and automated trailer loading and unloading technology to support the operation.

"This is exactly the kind of operation where Wagner's strengths come through," said Brian Smith, President and Chief Executive Officer of Wagner Logistics. "It requires speed, flexibility, close coordination and the ability to design a solution around what the customer actually needs."

#### New Kenosha hub significantly expands G10 Fulfillment’s Midwest warehouse capacity

 Posted in Kenosha County Economic Development 

A Delavan-based third-party logistics and fulfillment company has significantly expanded its Midwest warehouse capacity after moving into a new distribution facility in Kenosha.

G10 Fulfillment now occupies 315,000 square feet of a 600,000-square-foot building at 12345 38th St., just off Interstate 94. The move increases G10’s dock capacity to 65 doors from 30.

“The Midwest is probably the most important hub for us,” said co-founder and CEO Mark Becker, who was on hand Thursday for a ribbon-cutting at the facility. He pointed to the region’s freight infrastructure and its location along the trucking corridor between Chicago and Milwaukee.

Becker said the facility can handle nearly 7 acres of inventory under one roof. G10 shares the building with food manufacturer Eagle Foods.

G10 invested about $2 million in the Kenosha buildout, which Becker said covered racking, automation and staffing costs.

October 12, 2026

# ALO locating fulfillment and distribution operations in Southaven

- - Athletic apparel company creating more than 400 jobs 
- Project represents corporate investment of nearly $176 million

Jackson, Miss. (Oct. 12, 2026) – ALO, the fashion and lifestyle brand synonymous with premium studio-to-streetwear rooted in mind-body wellness, is locating a new national fulfillment and distribution center in Southaven. The project represents a corporate investment of nearly $176 million and will create more than 400 new jobs.

ALO is moving into an existing building and will occupy up to 1.2 million square feet, with the option to add returns processing operations at the facility.

The Mississippi Development Authority is providing assistance through the Mississippi Flexible Tax Incentive, or MFLEX, program. DeSoto County and the city of Southaven are assisting with the project, as well.

ALO began operations in August and plans to fill the new jobs by 2027.
